width.evidence: Four visible front post bays suggest a modest single-room span.

depth.evidence: Roof depth and side platform proportion are visible from the elevated view.

roof_pitch_deg.evidence: Both roof planes are visible and show a moderate pitch.

stone_step_count.evidence: Individual stone stair treads can be counted in the reference.

wood_age.evidence: Timber appears dark and weathered rather than freshly finished.

moss.evidence: Possible green-grey cliff variation is visible but moss cannot be isolated confidently.

observations.subject: composition
observations.statement: A compact timber kitchen/work shelter occupies a stone platform against a cliff mass.

observations.subject: access
observations.statement: A narrow flight of stone steps connects the exposed platform edge to lower terrain.

uncertainties: The rear wall is partly occluded by the roof and cliff.
Surface weathering cannot be separated reliably from low-saturation lighting.
